name: TutorLoom
description: Self-hosted learning platform for institutes and training teams.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The database (organizations, courses, people, progress), uploads in media/, Redis data, secret keys (state/secrets.env) and the first password (admin-password.txt). Back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: TutorLoom web app, API (/api), API docs (/api/docs/) and Django admin (/admin/), published on host as 6177

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: The address you open TutorLoom at, like http://192.168.1.20:6177. Used for the links in invite and password-reset emails. Change localhost to your server IP so those links work from other devices.

variables.name: ADMIN_EMAIL
variables.description: Your email. It becomes the first admin account (Institute Admin and Django admin). Set it before the first start.

variables.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: The password for that account. Leave it empty and one is made for you; it is in the app logs in the box marked CREDENTIALS. Only used on the first start.
